title: Bears DB Kyler Gordon: Return to lineup was "everything I wanted"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears DB Kyler Gordon: Return to lineup was "everything I wanted"
sources.description: Bears defensive back Kyler Gordon's lack of availability over the last two years has been a source of frustration for the Bears and his return to the lineup on Sunday illustrated why the team has missed him so much.
